candidate.data_scope: Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV plus historical is_liquid only

hypothesis.primary: Averaging capped portfolios across multiple partial refinement states and two fixed causal paths can preserve information that terminal hard-gating discards, while reducing dependence on a single predicate order.
hypothesis.root_state: cross-sectional 7-day Sharpe quality above mean + 0.20 sd
hypothesis.aggregation: equal weight across the quality root plus four prefixes from each path; nine books total, then 3-day causal smoothing

terminal_predicates.volatility: vol14 > 0 and below 1.35 times liquid cross-sectional mean

controls.base_sharpe7: Exact promoted Sharpe7 Vol2 incumbent formula.
controls.terminal: Use only the fully refined terminal intersection from path A.
controls.vote4: Static 4-of-5 support gate using root plus four predicates.
controls.single_path: Average only the root plus path-A prefixes.
controls.anti_quality: Invert the quality root while retaining the ensemble machinery.

selection_rule.multi_depth_value_must_repeat_in_researc: ensemble Sharpe must exceed terminal Sharpe at 4% ATR cost in both 2016-2020 and 2021-2022
